Çerezler ve tarayıcıda saklananlar: Cookies and data stored in the browser
<b>Analiz çerezleri</b> (<code>_ga</code: Analytics cookies (_ga, _ga_…): set by Google Analytics only if you give your consent, and kept for at most 2 years.
<b>Tercihler</b>: dil, tema ve çerez izn: Preferences: your language, theme and cookie consent choice are stored in your browser; they are not sent to the server.
<b>Oturum çerezi</b>: hesabınıza giriş y: Session cookie: when you sign in to your account, a required cookie is used to keep your session active.

Mastertool hesabınız için e-posta adresi: For your Mastertool account, your email address, your name and a verification digest derived from your password on your device are stored; your password itself is never sent to the server.
Uygulamalardaki bağlantı ve proje kayıtl: Your connection and project records in the apps are synced with end-to-end encryption; the encryption key is only on your devices, and the server cannot read the content.

İzninizi istediğiniz zaman verebilir ya: You can give or withdraw your consent at any time. When you withdraw it, analytics cookies are deleted.
